hints.title: Save the old color
hints.body: The starting color defines the region. If the new color is the same, stop immediately to avoid an infinite loop.

hints.title: Explore four neighbors
hints.body: From each repainted cell, visit up, down, left, and right cells that still have the old color.

hints.title: Mark before exploring
hints.body: Paint a cell when it is pushed so it cannot be visited twice.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
old = image[row][column]
if old == color: return image
stack = [(row, column)]
paint(row, column)
while stack is not empty:
    r, c = pop(stack)
    for each edge-neighbor (nr, nc):
        if inside and image[nr][nc] == old:
            paint(nr, nc)
            push((nr, nc))
return image
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
